nodes.label: Portfolio (Astro Edition)
nodes.rationale: Migrated from Laravel to Astro to become static-host friendly (Netlify/Vercel) while keeping a content-driven architecture.

nodes.label: Content-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: Projects, skills, testimonials and site settings are authored as Markdown/JSON content rather than hardcoded, enabling static builds and non-code content updates.

nodes.label: Mobile Hero Text-First Stacking
nodes.rationale: On mobile, stack text first and the ID card second and scale the card down, because readability should take priority and the fixed-size card overlapped hero content and navigation.

nodes.label: Realistic Draggable ID Card
nodes.rationale: Replace vanilla-tilt mouse-position tilt with a custom physics engine so the card feels weighty, swings on release like a lanyard object, and supports dragging on touch devices.

nodes.label: Fluid ID Card Sizing
nodes.rationale: A fixed 340px width caused horizontal overflow on small screens; w-full max-w-[340px] with aspect-[34/54] preserves the card ratio while scaling down gracefully.
